## Activity

During October 2023, North City Eye Clinic recorded 511 captures. This figure represents the total activity reported for the month. It provides the overall volume for consideration alongside the image quality and grading results below. The activity is reported as a capture count and is not presented as a separate count of people or examinations.

## Image quality

Of the recorded captures, 5 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.0 per cent. The count and rate are reported together to provide a clear summary of image quality for the month. The ungradable result indicates that the associated capture could not be used for grading. No additional image-quality measure is included in this report.

## Grading

Grading identified 120 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This is the median interval reported for the month and describes the time between the capture being made and the grading outcome being recorded. The referable result count and median lag are presented as the grading measures for North City Eye Clinic in October 2023.
